'''Nick Seistrup''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 8th or so at [[January 2001 Geneva tournament]] on 6 January 2001, according to Alex Helmke's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1608">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ geneva-illinois-01-06-00], DeckTech (Alex "aljex" Helmke, 9 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-09-geneva-illinois-01-06-00d1608/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
